data.claim: Resumability reduces to a single atomicity invariant: the event-append and the budget-decrement must be a single atomic transaction. A halted run is resumable iff the persisted state is the result of a sequence of completed transactions—each one either fully committed (event written + budget decremented + digest linked) or fully rolled back (neither persisted). Resumption must be refused iff the transaction log shows a split: an event persisted without a matching budget decrement, or a budget decrement without a matching event, or a partially committed transaction (event bytes present but digest not finalized).
